Frequently asked questions
Is Duolingo Math free?
Is Duolingo Math safe for my child to use?
Is Duolingo Math aligned to any Common Core standards?
Can Duolingo Math help my child do well in school?
What grade levels does Duolingo Math cover?
Does Duolingo Math offer a math tutor?
Duolingo’s tutor-like feature, Math Coach, offers lessons that adapt to how you learn and answer questions. Think of it as a tutor your child can tap for help anytime, anywhere!
Can my child jump to a specific Math topic or grade-level?
Yes. While the Duolingo Math course is organized by grade and topic, learners can jump directly to any unit or concept they need to review without completing prerequisites.
Can I use this app on my device?
Duolingo Math is available on iOS, Android, and web.
How do I switch between Math and my language course on Duolingo?
What languages is Duolingo Math available in?
We offer curriculum coverage for Grades 2–12 in English. We’ll be expanding to more languages in the future.
